name: Letter to Jin'Zil
summary: Darsok Swiftdagger sends you from the northern Barrens into Stonetalon Mountains with news for his old friend, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil. Serena Bloodfeather has fallen, and Darsok wants Jin'Zil to know.

sections.title: A Message into the Mountains
sections.body: Darsok Swiftdagger sends you into Stonetalon Mountains after Serena Bloodfeather falls. The Witchwing and Bloodfeather broods came from the rugged ridges northwest of the northern Barrens, not the scrublands. Now that you have defeated Serena, Darsok asks you to carry the news of her death to his old acquaintance, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil. Jin'Zil lives at the troll settlement of Malaka'jin, in the dangerous mountain peaks.

sections.title: Echoes of the Bloodfury Claws
sections.body: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil remembers an earlier campaign when he hears that Serena Bloodfeather has fallen. The shadow hunter Rokhan and the wandering Beastmaster Rexxar slew Serena's elder sister, Bloodfeather. Serena's death brings a sense of finality to the long feud between the Horde's frontier outposts and Kalimdor's bloodthirsty harpies.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Letter to Jin'Zil?
faq.answer: Darsok Swiftdagger gives you the task at the Crossroads in the Barrens, after you complete the hunt for Serena Bloodfeather.

faq.q: Where can I find Witch Doctor Jin'Zil?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil lives in a cave at Malaka'jin, a Darkspear troll encampment just off the main path into Stonetalon Mountains from the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Darsok send you to Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Darsok sends you to tell his old friend Jin'Zil that Serena Bloodfeather's death has broken the harpy threat. He also sends a capable adventurer toward the wider challenges facing the Horde in the Stonetalon peaks.

faq.q: What previous sister of Serena is Jin'Zil referring to?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil refers to Bloodfeather, Serena's elder sister, who terrorized Kalimdor years earlier. The shadow hunter Rokhan and the half-ogre warrior Rexxar slew her while traveling with the founding Horde.

faq.q: Is this quest part of a larger chain?
faq.answer: Yes. This follows Harpy Raiders, Harpy Lieutenants, and Serena Bloodfeather, and concludes the northern Barrens harpy hunt. It also points toward Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What faction can undertake this task?
faq.answer: Only the Horde can undertake this work. Darsok Swiftdagger and Witch Doctor Jin'Zil both serve the Horde frontier.

angles.text: As a Horde warrior, you carry the effort to secure the Barrens' internal trade routes into the contested Stonetalon Mountains.
As a troll, you find Jin'Zil's cave at Malaka'jin, an important spiritual and tactical outpost for Darkspear trolls securing the mountain approaches.
